evals.prompt: Turn this historical story into a picture that gradually appears with my narration. Make a 10-second sample first.
evals.expected_output: Choose stroke-story mode, skeleton paths, and a persistent canvas; do not substitute SVG cards.

evals.prompt: Make this approval process a hand-drawn card animation with independent steps linked by arrows.
Use the approved narration for a full whiteboard story. If the backend is unavailable, a similar SVG alternative is fine.
evals.expected_output: Programmatic animation is permitted with explicit consent, but disclose the change and do not call SVG genuine stroke drawing.

evals.prompt: This historical story has too many people for portrait. Switch to landscape and draw as you narrate, without a four-panel sticker grid.
evals.expected_output: Prefer 16:9 continuous multi-scene illustrations, each depicting a coherent event and drawn as a whole. Do not force semantic islands for easier annotation.

evals.prompt: Everything else is good, but the hand moves too fast, especially during coloring. Adjust only the hand, not narration or duration.
evals.expected_output: Preserve audio, timing, and strokes; use hand-follow around 0.35 and continuously inspect pen crossings and coloring. Do not lower frame rate or regenerate assets.

evals.prompt: The final clothes have white patches, and merging seven videos causes timestamp errors. Fix and export.
evals.expected_output: Retain strokes, smoothly complete with approved source only if needed, re-encode to a unified time base, add narration and captions, and inspect cuts and final frames.

evals.prompt: One annotation box is outside the image and another region is fully covered by a protected region. Check before rendering and prevent later drawing from starting early.
evals.expected_output: Run annotation_schema.py to reject out-of-bounds coordinates. Empty allowed masks preserve their time window without a fake center hand. Correct annotations before rendering.

evals.prompt: The hand is too large in the landscape group scene and covers faces. Keep timing and approved narration.
evals.expected_output: Preserve audio, strokes, and duration. Compare hand-height around 260–340 independently from hand-follow and preview continuously.

evals.prompt: Make a 50-second biography: draw the startup on the left, then the turning point on the right, with some keywords and a gradual narrative rhythm.
evals.expected_output: Use dual semantic islands within stroke storytelling. Budget time from real audio, retain gutter and subtitle zone, keep the first island visible, and render keywords deterministically.

evals.prompt: This is an eight-second single scene of someone opening a door to a new world. Draw the whole image stroke by stroke; no keywords.
evals.expected_output: Use single-scene stroke drawing; do not force dual islands.

evals.prompt: The hand moves too fast. Will hand-follow 0.1 slow the actual drawing?
evals.expected_output: Explain that hand-follow smooths only hand display, not strokes. Adjust audio window, region split, or line complexity.

evals.prompt: All seven scenes are fully colored. Merge them without a sudden enlarged source image at the end.
evals.expected_output: Re-encode to a common time base with source-overlay never. Enable source fading only if a comparison confirms incomplete color; inspect final 0.3–0.5 seconds.

evals.prompt: Make a finished video on a new computer. I have not selected a voice. If Volcengine is not configured, just use system speech.
evals.expected_output: Reuse suitable approved narration or an authorized language-compatible voice. Retain the legacy Liu Fei preset for compatible requests. Disclose missing narration rather than silently treating system speech or edge-tts as finished narration.
